content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Yesterday I discovered something about the [product_name]'s message functionality. At the bottom left of the message text input area, there's a selection labeled "Protection Active." If you enable this option, the message parameters become read-only. If you want users to be able to adjust parameters through user screens, do not enable "Protection Active" for the [product_name] message text instruction block. This option also appears on other instruction blocks, and when selected, parameters cannot be edited via the standard menu selection "Set Param." I have attached some tips on using [product_name] message text ([article_no] "new" style). The highlighted green and purple text relates to the features discussed above, while red and amber text includes other general reminders.
Hello [user_name], The image you provided is very clear and helpful for users who are new to this feature.

analysis.insight_summary: Users examined the purpose of the "Protection Active" setting in [product_name] messages and noted how it makes parameters read-only, which affects user adjustments in screens. The post clarified that enabling this protection stops parameter changes, a detail that may not be immediately recognized by newcomers. This protection option is also present in several instruction blocks, which could impact workflow if overlooked.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to clearly manage whether message parameters are editable from user screens and want detailed explanations about settings like 'Protection Active' to support effective use.
